title: Nvidia and Abridge, maker of an AI note-taking app for doctors, are training an AI model for clinical conversations using de-identified data and Nemotron models (Belle Lin/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Belle Lin / Wall Street Journal: Nvidia and Abridge, maker of an AI note-taking app for doctors, are training an AI model for clinical conversations using de-identified data and Nemotron models — The chip giant is joining with the maker of AI note-taking technology to train a model tailored for clinical conversations
